full_text: Constitutional sheriffs Self-described constitutional sheriffs assert that they are the supreme legal authority with the power and duty to defy or disregard laws they regard as unconstitutional. As the election approaches it would be prudent to keep an eye on the activities of any local sheriff who is an advocate of this ultra right wing fringe group. They do not advertise their association with the constitutional sheriffs movement, however they seem to relish official communications stating they will not enforce CDC or ATF rules. My local sheriff has been vocal about the his own power to "protect the constitution". In the last six months the movement has mobilized across the US, building relationships with powerful figures close to Trump, training armed militias, and laying out plans for when Democrats inevitably, in their view, try to steal the election. They’re laying the groundwork to challenge the outcome of the vote and recruiting to help them assert control if Trump loses. They are described by the Southern Poverty Law Center as an anti-government organization with links to many other extremist groups. It would be great to know exactly who these fanatics are. So far I know of only two in Wisconsin who seem to fit the profile: Racine county sheriff Christofer Schmaling and Polk county sheriff Brent Waak.
